output: Yes, consultations are free. A consultation is a 30-minute session with one of our equipment specialists to help you choose and set up equipment for your cafe or bakery. We don't take any deposit. You can choose a phone call, a video call, or a visit to the showroom. Consultations are available Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm Pacific Time. If you'd like to book one, just let me know a preferred time.
